name: Toshimaen
tagline: Shinjuku in 21 minutes and Shibuya in 31 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, where Seibu and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 40 minutes to Otemachi, 21 minutes to Shinjuku, 31 minutes to Shibuya and 52 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 40.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 10.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 40.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 30.5 m to 41.4 m, a difference of 10.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 11 clinics and 12 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 秀佑会東海病院, about 15 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 総合東京病院, about 34 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Seibu Toshima Line and Toei Oedo Line. The lines are split between operators (Seibu runs 1 line and the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. Seibu Toshima Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000, 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nerima is ahead on the number of lines, but Toshimaen is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 5 minutes sooner than Toshimaen.

neighbours.lead: Nakamurabashi is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Toshimaen is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: About 1 km away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Toshimaen.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want a park close by
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The nearest big road, 目白通り, is far enough that little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 11 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: The big roads are far enough that traffic noise is unlikely to bother you.
